skill_name: Cloud Security, Cost Optimization & High Availability / DR
subtopic: Disaster Recovery Strategies (Backup & Restore, Pilot Light, Warm Standby, Multi-Region Active-Active)
question_text: [Cloud Security, Cost Optimization & High Availability / DR - Q10] Which cloud Disaster Recovery (DR) strategy offers the lowest Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO), at the highest operational cost?
answer_explanation: Multi-Region Active-Active serves production traffic simultaneously across two or more geographical cloud regions with real-time continuous replication, providing near-zero RTO and RPO.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: D. Rationale: Multi-Region Active-Active serves production traffic simultaneously across two or more geographical cloud regions with real-time continuous replication, providing near-zero RTO and RPO.
